opening.text: I've been feeling tired and I've had trouble concentrating. I get short of breath when I exert myself, and I've been feeling dizzy. I've also been getting pain in my fingers or toes. The tiredness, the trouble concentrating and the breathlessness started about 3 weeks ago. I have high blood pressure and I take enalapril for it. I smoke half a pack of cigarettes a day, and have since I was 20.
